name: Oneiros
summary: In northern Feralas, green dragonkin guard Oneiros and its ancient night elven ruins. The stones lie south of Jademir Lake, near portals that lead toward Ysera's realm.

sections.title: Ruins Beneath the Dream
sections.body: In northern Feralas, broken arches and columns mark an ancient Kaldorei settlement. Abandoned millennia ago, its stones are now threaded with roots and overgrowth. Green Dragonflight guardians patrol the shaded paths and ruined plazas, keeping mortals from ancient secrets.

sections.title: Echoes and Corruption
sections.body: Green dragonkin loyal to the Dreamer watch over Oneiros, where a spiritual link to the Emerald Dream makes the region volatile. Beyond the veil, darkness stirs. Powerful dragonspawn see any mortal who enters as a possible threat to the wards holding back corruption.

faq.answer: Oneiros lies in northern Feralas, directly south of Jademir Lake and north of the forest's main thoroughfares. It lies near the Great Tree that borders the Emerald Dream portal.
Powerful green dragonspawn and dragonkin sworn to the Green Dragonflight patrol Oneiros. These elite guardians are formidable, so travelers should approach with caution.

faq.q: Why are there night elf ruins here?
faq.answer: Oneiros was an ancient night elven settlement from before the Great Sundering. Its civilization crumbled over ten thousand years ago, leaving stone colonnades and courtyards for nature to reclaim.

faq.q: What is the connection between Oneiros and the Emerald Dream?
faq.answer: Oneiros lies near great boughs connecting Kalimdor to the Dream realm, where the boundaries between the physical and spirit worlds blur.

faq.q: Is there a safe place to rest nearby?
faq.answer: There is no safe place to rest within the ruins, which belong to green dragonkin. Alliance travelers can retreat to Feathermoon Stronghold off the western coast, while the Horde can shelter at Camp Mojache in eastern Feralas.

angles.text: As a druid, you may feel reverence and concern for Oneiros, whose ethereal link reaches Ysera's domain and whose dangers include lingering Nightmare corruption.
As a Night Elf, you can see in Oneiros a solemn reminder of your ancient empire's reach and the green dragonkin's vigilant guardianship.
